question: Can one unified multi-task Skill update repair actual failures while preserving native successes in the fixed Train batch?
Can round1 measured edit-response knowledge change round2 direction, scope or coordination and receive corresponding execution feedback?
hypothesis: A shared semantic decision structure can organize current requirements and conditional edit responses, allowing evidence-based nonuniform updates without assuming independent groups or numerical preconditioning.

data.old_train_results_use: Preselection coverage only; not fed to classification, Diagnosis, Fusion, Editor or Memory.

summary.preserve: Current request, actual Parent, visible protocol/policy/tools/capabilities, initial observation, ordered actions and post-observations, source references, native outcome and completeness. Preserve loops and invalid actions.
summary.deduplicate: Shared context and complete repeated admissible-command lists only.
summary.exclude: Model reasoning, HTTP noise, hidden environment labels/state/answers, task selection rationale, historical outcomes and previous update artifacts.

classification.scope: All current complete Parent summaries at once.
classification.partition: Every task exactly once; singletons allowed; no prescribed group count.
classification.criterion: Comparable concrete decision problem and observed relevant conditions; never business/tool/family/outcome alone.
classification.cross_round_matching: Decision semantics, conditions, actual edit and current Parent dependencies; not group IDs.

rounds.parent: round1 fully published Skill (Candidate on ACCEPT, unchanged Parent on RETAIN)
rounds.memory: round1 fully published effective Memory (possibly empty)

replay.conditions: Same reset task, seed, actor protocol/model/parameters and step limit; verify saved conditions.
replay.before_gate: Mechanical paired execution facts and native outcomes.
replay.after_gate: One joint semantic behavior interpretation and Memory update, not a second Replay review call.
replay.condition_scope: Within one round: task + actual Skill + recorded execution conditions. Parent and Candidate each execute once on the same batch. Train tasks never repeat between rounds; no separate regression-validation batch.

gate.eligibility: For a measured comparison: distinct actual Candidate; all ten pairs complete, provenance valid and recorded conditions matching. For legal no_change: all ten Parent runs complete and bound, no Candidate comparison fabricated.
gate.accept: candidate_success_rate > parent_success_rate (equivalently candidate_success_count > parent_success_count for the same ten complete pairs)
gate.repair: parent native failure -> candidate native success
gate.regression: parent native success -> candidate native failure
gate.retain: Eligible complete comparison not satisfying ACCEPT.
gate.scope: Overall version promotion on this complete Train batch. Local improvements, regressions and unknown behavior belong in Memory, regardless of ACCEPT or RETAIN; no zero-regression veto or proof of stable benefit.
gate.validation_failure: Missing, technical unknown or mismatched evidence: save the error, produce no valid Gate decision, keep last published state and stop further rounds.
gate.no_change: Legal no candidate/change: RETAIN with reason=no_change, after complete Parent verification. Candidate score is absent, not an observed tie; publish unchanged Parent and valid prior-memory processing/no-op.

memory.order: Replay -> Gate -> formal Memory update -> publish
memory.candidate_scope: Main branch only; preserve accepted/rejected provenance and bundled attribution.
memory.association: Frozen decision-problem semantic snapshot and conditions in source/basis, alongside actual edit, paired evidence and Gate archive.
memory.parent_only: When no actual edit, only revise/limit existing knowledge from current observations; never invent a new measured edit effect. Empty initial Memory may remain unchanged without a model call.

publication.mechanism: One immutable round-end record binds selected Skill, effective Memory, Gate status and source hashes.
publication.memory_or_publication_failure: Do not advance either published reference; preserve pending artifacts and stop.
publication.no_candidate: Publish unchanged Skill with valid Memory processing/no-op when semantically settled, never fabricate a Candidate evaluation.

stop_rules: No outcome-driven task replacement, post-Replay revision, candidate retry, extra screening, or Selection/Test execution.
No Train task repeats between rounds; no Direct or other parallel candidate branch in this campaign.
Incomplete Parent batch, oversized input, invalid grouping or main construction technical failure stops the mainline; do not relabel as no_change.
Main Replay without ten complete comparable pairs fails Gate validation and stops publication/next round; do not label technical errors RETAIN.
Legal no_change, need_evidence, needs_revision, empty Memory and Keep are retained honestly; no actual edit means no new measured edit effect.
Memory processing/publication technical failure preserves the previous published pair and stops; no automatic recovery call in this protocol.

design_now: Task list, selection sources and budget
required_before_first_live_request: Actual runner and all source hashes
All stage prompt bodies and hashes
per_round: Gate then learning output then publication

claims_excluded: Independent semantic blocks or isolated edit causality from bundled results
Statistically stable advantage from ten tasks
Classification causal benefit without a corresponding ablation
